title: St. Nicholas Square Santa’s Belt 14 oz Mug Christmas
descriptionText: The St. Nicholas Square Santa's Belt 14 oz Mug is a festive Christmas collectible featuring a design inspired by Santa Claus. Perfect for enjoying your favorite hot beverages during the holiday season, this mug is adorned with Santa's belt design, adding a touch of holiday cheer to your drinkware collection.
